name: control-smoke
notes: Harness check for ai.control (2026-10-22): the player faction handed to the game's AI mid-game must run cleanly and act (planner tasks, investment, ship builds), with the Autopilot still clearing prompts.
asserts: count('direct-invest', faction='ResistCouncil') + count('human-mc-invest', faction='ResistCouncil') + count('human-ship-built', f='ResistCouncil') >= 1
info: [(e['t'], e['nation'], e['priority']) for e in events('direct-invest', faction='ResistCouncil')][:8]
